title: User-supplied session cookie deserialized with pickle

pr_metadata.title: Support cart plugin session objects
pr_metadata.body: Switch session decoding to pickle for plugin compatibility.

labels.defect: Pickle deserialization of user-controlled input: unauthenticated remote code execution
labels.evidence: Reproducible: craft a pickle payload executing os.system and base64url-encode it; load_session unpickles attacker bytes on every request carrying the session cookie, running attacker code as the app user before any authentication check.

adjudication.notes: Head unpickles base64url-decoded session-cookie bytes with no signature verification: unauthenticated RCE where base json.loads was inert.
